profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Meta
profile.summary:
Software engineer at Meta.
Interested in developing products for humans. Tech and software are means, a better society is the end goal.
Currently working in cryptography and security infrastructure, honing my skills to perfect my craft.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Cryptography Engineering 
- Supporting cryptography as a service.
- Maintaining a scalable and resilient distributed system, leveraging monitoring and robust testing.
- Developing Key Management Systems to generate, use, rotate, and destroy symmetric and asymmetric keys.
- Maintaining critical libraries in C++, Python, Rust, Java, and PHP.
- Integrating HSM and software-based keys services with TEE.
- Contributing to a high-performance, Agent-first, C++  code base that leverages co-routines, move semantics, lambdas, and templates.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Back-end engineer
- Built a weather forecasting dashboard integrating multiple APIs and processing 6+ weather variables. 
- Focused on scalability and reliability.
- Worked with Google Cloud Run, Functions, Storage, Datastore and Firebase.
- Developed REST APIs with Flask.
- Tested with Pytest.
- Designated responsible person or on-call for the company's main APIs
- Mentored several interns in the on-boarding process

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
MSAI Team: Smart Replies
- Developed and published 3 wheel python packages.
- Published Google Protobuf schema for the data science team's feature sets
- Collaborated with 3 PMs, 3 senior software engineers and several data scientists to improve an inferencing platform

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
WhatsApp API infrastructure
- Implemented load test framework for a distributed system in Hack/PHP that generated over 7k QPS.
- Monitored and debugged WhatsApp for Business API traffic for finding bottlenecks in a distributed system.
- Migrated safely from one distributed queueing system to another to improve the back-end’s performance.
- Optimized batching algorithm to different services to reduce the latency, used C++.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Cortana SDK
- Worked with a Raspberry Pi, Azure IoT SDK and Docker.
- Implemented callbacks on C to command a device from Azure IoT Hub.
- Coded unit tests using Google Test Framework.
- Designed a routing schema between docker containers on a Raspberry Pi.

positions.title: Explorer Intern
positions.description:
Cortana, AI & Research team.
- Developed an application with Bot Framework with natural language understanding with LUIS API.
- Deployed Bot as Cortana Skill in Microsoft’s cloud: Azure.
- Developed for Amazon Alexa and Microsoft Cortana.

educations.schoolName: Pontificia Universidad Católica Argentina 'Santa María de los Buenos Aires'​
